The Artist

Hi, I'm Durai.

By day I work a full-time job. Before and after it, I draw. Durai Arts is where that second life lives — realistic pencil portraits built layer by layer, grade by grade, for people who want a likeness that took real hours, not filters.

Every commission starts with your reference photo and ends with a piece framed and ready to hang. I take a limited number of portraits each month, so each one gets the time it needs.

How a Portrait Is Built

Four grades, one likeness.

Every portrait moves through the same graphite scale — light to dark — so the final piece holds real depth, not just outline.

HB

Sketch & Structure

Proportions, guidelines, and the first light pass of the face.

2B

Base Shading

Mid-tones are built across skin, hair, and background.

4B

Depth & Contrast

Shadows deepen, features sharpen, likeness starts to hold.

8B

Final Detail

Darkest darks, fine hair strands, and the last highlights lifted with an eraser.

Commissioning a Portrait

How It Works

A simple four-step process, from first message to a piece at your door.

01

Book an Appointment

Message first to confirm your slot — orders are taken by appointment only, no walk-in urgent requests.

02

Confirm & Advance

Choose your size — A5, A4, or A3 — and confirm the order with an initial advance amount.

03

2–3 Days to Draw

Each portrait is hand-drawn during evening hours (7–10 PM), around my day job — quality over rush.

04

Delivery

Free delivery within the city. Outstation orders are shipped at a small extra charge.
